resources.string: Move messages from an exact sender into a local folder after each POP3 sync. Saving also applies the rule to messages already in Inbox. Server copies stay available to Outlook.
Working… downloading any incomplete messages before moving them.
Add a POP3 account to create local rules.
Rule stopped. The folder and its messages are kept.
Folder unavailable — save the rule again
Enter one complete email address and a folder name of 1–100 characters, without slashes or line breaks.
That name belongs to a special or server folder. Choose another local folder name.
The operation could not finish. Check the account and try again. Any saved rules remain visible when you reopen this screen.
Rule saved. Messages moved: %1$d. Still in Inbox: %2$d (retried at the next sync).
Folders appear in the account folder list and exist only on this device. Stopping a rule keeps its folder and messages. Rules are stored on this device and are not included in settings exports.
